signatures.description: DF-AIPP-11: Dashboard control buttons sent session_id in JSON body but FastAPI handlers declared it as query param. FastAPI silently used default=\"default\", so Pause/Stop affected wrong session. Fix: changed UI to send session_id on query string for all 4 control endpoints, added TestControlTransportQueryParam test that pins transport shape.
